title: Point Separation for Adjoint Line Bundles
summary: Let X be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension n and let L be an ample line bundle. Using the freeness and minimization inputs specified in the introduction, we prove that KX + mL separates distinct points for every integer m ≥ n + 2, the sharp bound predicted by Fujita’s very ampleness conjecture. Exponential-moment convergence produces point-centred minimizing valuations at both points in a common degree.
